thread:
marta_support: FYI customer Acme Corp is seeing an empty CSV when exporting the Billing Usage report for ranges > 30 days. They attached the download and it's 0 bytes.

alex_eng: Can you paste the exact flow you used, Marta? Is this the console export or the API presigned flow?

marta_support: Console export -> Console triggers backend export job which returns presigned S3 URL. Customer opened URL and got 0 bytes. Happened for 2 different Acme users (same org). Happened ~10:12 UTC.

marta_support: Repro steps from customer:
1) Open Console -> Analytics -> Billing Usage
2) Set date range 2025-10-01 to 2025-11-30 (60 days)
3) Click Export CSV -> download.zip -> extraction shows report.csv with 0 bytes

kenji_data: Anything in the export job logs? Marta, can you share the job id if available?

marta_support: Job id: export_job_20251130_4821 (they copied from UI). Console shows "export queued" then "export completed". No obvious error in UI.

alex_eng: I'm checking analytics-service logs. Quick grep for job id shows the export job wrote a presigned URL but upstream query returned empty resultset. Looks like the export pipeline continued and uploaded an empty file.

alex_eng: Repro locally with same query + range -> I get rows. Suspect pagination code path when date range spans multiple partitions.

kenji_data: We recently shipped a partitioning optimization that changes how the warehouse query uses UNION across partitions. If one partition query error triggers, our exporter used to fail but a change made it swallow certain SQL exceptions and produce empty resultset.

olivia_product: Oof. Is this the #analytics-partition-rollout from last week? We had a canary that was supposed to be behind a feature flag.

alex_eng: Yes that flag accidentally got enabled in prod for all orgs during the release. Deploy bot shows a rollout at 2025-11-30T09:58Z.

deploy-bot: Release 2025.11.30.02 deployed by ci/cd-pipeline. Canary flag analytics.partitioning.enabled = true set in config-service.

ops_oncall: For immediate mitigation we can toggle the feature flag off. That will revert to the old query path and should stop empty uploads.

marta_support: Customer needs a short-term workaround. Can we suggest they limit to 30-day chunks for now?

alex_eng: Yes, advise 30-day chunks as a temporary workaround. I'm going to flip the flag now and watch for errors.

alex_eng: Flipped flag at 2025-11-30T10:15Z. Monitoring: export error rate alert dropped to baseline.

kenji_data: Created PR to make exporter bubble SQL errors instead of swallowing them: PR#4721. Will add a guard to ensure we abort uploads on empty dataset.

olivia_product: Filing a customer incident and will offer Acme a regenerated export once hotfix is in. Ticket: INC-2025-1193.

marta_support: I told Acme to try again; they confirmed regenerated export link now contains full CSV. They still want root cause and timeline.

alex_eng: Root cause summary for the incident postmortem: partitioning optimization enabled globally by mistake; a SQL edge-case produced no rows and exporter did not fail the job, leading to 0-byte S3 upload. Hotfix: PR#4721 merged, deploy scheduled. Rollback (flag flip) used as immediate mitigation.

kenji_data: Follow-ups: add unit tests for UNION edge case, add telemetry metric for "export_row_count" and alert if zero rows for non-empty time ranges, and add an e2e that verifies downloaded CSV size > 0 for >30d ranges. Jira: DATA-3145.

olivia_product: I'll coordinate comms and offer Acme a credit for the trouble.

marta_support: Closing loop with customer now. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

alex_eng: Noted, will keep monitoring exports for similar anomalies. :eyes:
